summary.intent: Execute Phase 50 (IPFS/IPNS Data-Integrity Fixes) of the CipherBox project via the GSD manager, implementing 5 plans across 2 waves to fix integer-overflow, refcount-drain, subtree-traversal, and unpin-integrity bugs in the IPFS/IPNS subsystem.
summary.outcome: All 5 plans executed and merged, code review found 2 blockers (cycle guard missing, unhandled promise rejections) that were fixed, verification passed all 3 must-have goals, phase marked complete with todos resolved, and a /simplify pass was initiated with 2 extractions identified for application.

repo: pnpm api:generate (orval) resolves to the workspace root, not the active worktree — running it inside a worktree leaks 131+ regenerated api-client files into the main working tree
packages/sdk build similarly leaks output to the main tree (client.ts) when the SDK is built from a worktree without isolated node_modules
The gsd commit helper has a known false-negative: reports commit_failed but the commit actually lands — always verify with git log
cleanup-wave merges fail silently with empty stderr when the pre-commit hook (lint-staged across 131+ api-client files) cannot complete the internal git commit step
todos/done/ (70 items, frozen ~Jun 15) and todos/completed/ (20 items, current) coexist; GSD tooling references completed/ exclusively — done/ is legacy drift, never migrated
GSD dep-string parser mis-parses 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' as phantom phase 1.1, falsely marking deps unsatisfied; manual dep verification required when phase name contains version strings
5 REQ-IDs (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) are missing from the REQUIREMENTS traceability table — pre-existing doc-sync debt surfaced by phase.complete

code.finding: collectSubtreeIpnsNamesAsync recursed at lines 220/246/316 with no visited set despite docstring claiming to mirror ensureFolderLoaded DFS pattern — folder cycle causes unbounded recursion; fixed with visited guard added
4 fire-and-forget unenroll dispatch sites used .then() with no .catch() — unhandled rejections silently drop unenroll work; fixed by adding .catch() to all 4 sites
Added refcount recheck guard under advisory lock — skips physical unpin in drain when CID is re-pinned, preventing data loss on concurrent re-pin during drain
fileUnpins.inc() was firing on no-op paths; now gated by rowDeleted flag. outboxRowInserted renamed to shouldAttemptPhysicalUnpin. recordUnpin deleted (zero callers).
UnpinDto.cid now enforces @MaxLength(255) and @Matches CIDv0/CIDv1 regex — required api-client regen of 132 files to satisfy pre-commit check-api-client.sh hook
Backfill candidate query was selecting rows newer than 1 hour — now excludes pinned_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' to prevent in-flight uploads from being deleted as phantoms

workflow: On Claude Code runtime, plan/execute phases must run inline (not backgrounded) — backgrounded agents cannot nest subagents, silently disabling worktree isolation and the plan-checker
Wave-based parallel worktree execution: worktrees fork off current HEAD (not main) so PLAN.md files are available; base-check via shouldDegrade flag confirms this before dispatch
When cleanup-wave fails opaquely, manually inspect MERGE_HEAD — if merge applied cleanly with no conflicts, complete the commit manually with hooks enabled rather than force-pushing
Husky regenerates .husky/_/* hook stubs as untracked files when pnpm install runs inside a worktree; clean these before merging or they block the merge helper's dirty-tree check
WR-01 accepted trade-off: drain now holds advisory lock across Kubo network call — low-frequency batched path, correctness prioritized over lock duration

friction: pnpm api:generate in 50-05 worktree leaked 131 modified api-client files into main working tree, blocking cleanup-wave merge for 50-05 and 50-03
cleanup-wave helper produced opaque merge_failed + empty stderr when lint-staged couldn't complete its internal commit — required manual MERGE_HEAD diagnosis and manual commit
Husky regenerated .husky/_/ stubs as untracked files in 50-05 worktree, blocking the first merge attempt
GSD dep-string parser mis-parsed Phase 49 dependency, suppressing the auto-recommendation for Phase 50 and requiring manual override
gsd commit helper consistently reports commit_failed even on successful commits — adds verification overhead after every tracking update
macOS mktemp silently left XXXXXX literal mid-template (BSD behavior differs from GNU) — cosmetic but unexpected
open_items: WR-02: RegisterCidDto uses {44} regex while UnpinDto uses {44,} — divergent CID validation; deferred todo created
WR-05: LocalProvider passes unescaped CID in shell-adjacent path — deferred todo created
Shared withCidLock+refcount primitive: advisory-lock SQL inlined 3 times in vault.service.ts — accepted debt, flagged for future extraction
IpfsModule leaf extraction: circular import comment is factually wrong per /simplify reviewer (IPFS_PROVIDER only needs ConfigService) — deferred
todos/done/ vs todos/completed/ consolidation: 70 legacy items in done/ never migrated to completed/
/simplify extractions pending application: fireAndForgetUnenrollEntries (collapses 3 copy-paste dispatch blocks) and collectFolderSubtree (collapses 2 duplicated unwrap+delegate+fallback branches)
